description: Changelog and full-project gate for findings F2-F5 of review idp-2026-10-06. Records the security fixes and the two deployment-impacting changes (trust_proxy default flip; new required/recommended IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY) in CHANGELOG.md, then runs the complete lint + test + coverage gate. Must run after FEAT-001..004. Does NOT create the overall security-review response doc (handled separately).
steps: In CHANGELOG.md, under the `## [Unreleased]` section, add a `### Security` subsection (create if absent) with entries referencing review idp-2026-10-06: F2 - OAuth JWT no longer placed in logged URL query strings (delivered via URL fragment) and admin audit-log moved to a POST with the step-up token in the body + Cache-Control: no-store; F4 - audit hash chain keyed by a dedicated IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY (never the app secret), chain verified at startup and on each audit-log render, stdout mirror redacted (User-Agent hashed/omitted, username truncated); F5 - session cookie resurrection fixed (new users get a non-resettable session_epoch; deleted usernames leave a persisted epoch tombstone).

In CHANGELOG.md under `## [Unreleased]`, add a `### Changed` subsection (create if absent) noting the two deployment-impacting changes: create_app/IDP_TRUST_PROXY now defaults to false (F3) so a direct deployment keeps the real socket peer address — set IDP_TRUST_PROXY=true only behind a trusted reverse proxy/ingress; and IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY is a new recommended setting for a stable, verifiable audit chain across restarts.

Ensure the worktree data dir has the gitignored test fixtures before running the gate: if `python -m pytest` fails with FileNotFoundError for data/idp.key, run `cp /Users/topazb/repos/identity-provider/data/idp.key /Users/topazb/repos/identity-provider/data/users.json /Users/topazb/repos/identity-provider/.worktrees/sec-f2-f5-medium/data/`. Do NOT git add these files (they are gitignored).

Run the full gate from the worktree root and fix anything that fails: ruff check identity_provider_server/ ; bandit -r identity_provider_server/ -q ; python -m pytest --cov=identity_provider_server --cov-report=term-missing -q (coverage must reach 100%, pyproject fail_under=100; add targeted tests for any uncovered new lines).
